experiments.name: Baseline Game Trajectory Synthesis
experiments.description: Synthesize complete game trajectories with weather/opponent conditioning
experiments.hypothesis: cVAE can generate realistic game progression paths

experiments.name: Rushing Yard Trajectory Prediction
experiments.description: Model RB rushing yard accumulation throughout game
experiments.hypothesis: Conditional on game state, we can predict rushing trajectory

experiments.name: Passing Yard Trajectory Prediction
experiments.description: Model QB passing yard accumulation with situational factors
experiments.hypothesis: Pass-heavy game scripts increase variance in passing trajectories

experiments.name: Reception Trajectory (PPR Scoring)
experiments.description: Model WR/TE reception counts and timing across quarters
experiments.hypothesis: Target share and game script drive reception trajectories

experiments.name: TD Timing Prediction
experiments.description: Predict WHEN in game touchdowns occur (early/mid/late)
experiments.hypothesis: TD timing varies by game script and situational pressure

experiments.name: Game Script Emergence
experiments.description: Model how game script (pass-heavy vs rush-heavy) evolves
experiments.hypothesis: Early scoring drives influence entire game trajectory

experiments.name: Blowout vs Close Game Trajectories
experiments.description: Distinguish trajectory patterns for competitive vs non-competitive games
experiments.hypothesis: Blowouts have distinct statistical signatures detectable early

experiments.name: Multi-Horizon Trajectory Forecasting
experiments.description: Separate cVAE models for Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4/Final predictions
experiments.hypothesis: Quarter-specific models capture intra-game regime changes

experiments.name: Weather-Conditioned Trajectories
experiments.description: Model impact of temperature, wind, precipitation on trajectories
experiments.hypothesis: Extreme weather reduces passing volume and increases variance

experiments.name: Injury-Adjusted Trajectories
experiments.description: In-game injury scenarios and replacement player trajectories
experiments.hypothesis: Key player injuries cause regime shifts in game trajectory

experiments.name: Home/Away Trajectory Asymmetry
experiments.description: Model home field advantage effects on trajectory variance
experiments.hypothesis: Home teams have lower variance due to crowd/familiarity

experiments.name: Divisional Rivalry Trajectories
experiments.description: Capture unique trajectory patterns in divisional games
experiments.hypothesis: Rivalry games have higher variance and unpredictability

experiments.name: Prime Time Game Trajectories
experiments.description: Model performance differences in SNF/MNF/TNF games
experiments.hypothesis: Prime time games have different pacing and scoring patterns

experiments.name: Playoff-Bound Team Trajectories
experiments.description: Model late-season games where playoff seeding is locked
experiments.hypothesis: Teams resting starters have predictable trajectory changes

experiments.name: Rookie QB Trajectory Patterns
experiments.description: Model unique trajectory characteristics of rookie QBs
experiments.hypothesis: Rookie QBs have higher variance and learn over season

experiments.name: Two-Minute Drill Trajectories
experiments.description: Model end-of-half/game hurry-up offense patterns
experiments.hypothesis: Two-minute situations have distinct trajectory signatures

experiments.name: Offensive Coordinator Change Trajectories
experiments.description: Model trajectory shifts after OC/HC changes mid-season
experiments.hypothesis: Coaching changes cause regime shifts in play distribution

experiments.name: Stack Correlation Trajectories
experiments.description: Model QB-WR stack correlations in DFS contexts
experiments.hypothesis: Stack correlations vary by game script and matchup

experiments.name: Defense-Adjusted Trajectory Variance
experiments.description: Model how defensive quality affects trajectory uncertainty
experiments.hypothesis: Elite defenses reduce offensive trajectory variance

experiments.name: Season Progression Meta-Learning
experiments.description: Meta-learn how trajectory patterns evolve across season
experiments.hypothesis: Teams change as season progresses (injuries, scheme evolution)

experiments.name: Weather Impact on Rushing Performance
experiments.description: DiD estimation of precipitation/wind effects on rushing yards
experiments.hypothesis: Bad weather increases rushing attempts and reduces passing efficiency

experiments.name: Injury Causation on Team Performance
experiments.description: Synthetic control for key player injuries on team outcomes
experiments.hypothesis: QB injury has largest causal effect on team point differential

experiments.name: Home Field Advantage Causal Effect
experiments.description: Regression discontinuity on home vs away performance
experiments.hypothesis: Home field advantage has declined over time (crowd effects)

experiments.name: Rest Days Impact on Performance
experiments.description: IV estimation using Thursday night games as instrument
experiments.hypothesis: Short rest causally reduces performance (fatigue effect)

experiments.name: QB Change Causal Effect on Offense
experiments.description: DiD with team fixed effects for QB changes
experiments.hypothesis: Veteran QB replacements improve offensive efficiency

experiments.name: Play-Calling Tendency Causal Analysis
experiments.description: Propensity score matching for run vs pass play selection
experiments.hypothesis: Passing on 1st down causally increases drive success rate

experiments.name: Coaching Change Impact on Win Rate
experiments.description: Synthetic control for mid-season coaching changes
experiments.hypothesis: Coaching changes have minimal short-term causal effect

experiments.name: Offensive Line Quality Causal Effect
experiments.description: DiD using OL injuries as natural experiment
experiments.hypothesis: OL quality causally affects both rushing and passing outcomes

experiments.name: Target Share Causal Effect on WR Production
experiments.description: IV using teammate injuries as instrument for target share
experiments.hypothesis: Target share has causal but non-linear effect on efficiency

experiments.name: Defensive Scheme Change Causal Effect
experiments.description: DiD for teams switching defensive coordinators
experiments.hypothesis: Scheme changes have delayed causal effects (learning period)

experiments.name: Altitude Causal Effect on Passing
experiments.description: Regression discontinuity using Denver altitude as treatment
experiments.hypothesis: High altitude causally increases passing distance but not accuracy

experiments.name: Travel Distance Causal Effect on Performance
experiments.description: DiD using cross-country travel as treatment
experiments.hypothesis: Long-distance travel causally impairs performance via fatigue

experiments.name: Play-Action Usage Causal Effect
experiments.description: Propensity score matching for play-action vs standard dropback
experiments.hypothesis: Play-action causally increases yards per attempt

experiments.name: Fourth Down Aggression Causal Effect
experiments.description: IV using coaching philosophy as instrument
experiments.hypothesis: 4th down aggression causally improves win probability

experiments.name: Red Zone Personnel Causal Effect
experiments.description: DiD for teams switching to heavy personnel in red zone
experiments.hypothesis: Heavy personnel causally increases TD conversion rate

experiments.name: Crowd Noise Causal Effect on Penalties
experiments.description: Natural experiment using COVID empty stadiums
experiments.hypothesis: Crowd noise causally increases false start penalties

experiments.name: Game Script Causal Effect on Play Distribution
experiments.description: IV using early scoring as instrument for game script
experiments.hypothesis: Trailing teams causally increase pass rate non-linearly

experiments.name: Turf Type Causal Effect on Injuries
experiments.description: DiD using stadium turf changes as treatment
experiments.hypothesis: Artificial turf causally increases lower-body injury rate

experiments.name: Timeout Strategy Causal Effect on Drive Success
experiments.description: Propensity score matching for timeout usage timing
experiments.hypothesis: Early timeout usage causally impairs late-game clock management

experiments.name: Draft Capital Causal Effect on Player Usage
experiments.description: Regression discontinuity using draft position cutoffs
experiments.hypothesis: High draft picks get more opportunities despite performance
